SYLLABUSES FOR THE DEGREE OF BACHELOR OF ARTS (constructed test document, fictional)
MAJORS AND MINORS OFFERED BY THE FACULTY
HISTORY
Major (72 credits)
(A) Introductory courses: (12 credits)
HIST1001. World history to 1500 (6 credits)
An introduction to world history before 1500.
Assessment: 50% coursework, 50% examination.
HIST1002. Modern China and the world: a survey of political,
economic and social change (6
credits)
A survey of modern China.
Prerequisite: Nil
Assessment: 100% coursework.
HIST2001. Historical methods (6 credits)
Students learn to read sources critically. HIST1001 is a good preparation.
Prerequisite: HIST1001 and (HIST1002 or HIST1003). Non-permissible combination: HIST2099.
Assessment: 60% coursework, 40% examination.
HIST3001. Research seminar (capstone experience) (6 credits)
Prerequisite: At least one 2000-level History course.
Assessment: 100% coursework.
